And in his thirty-eighth year,
Sarah his mother died, being one hundred and twenty-seven years old.
And after one year, he took Rebekah.
And in his sixtieth year she conceived;
and she went to Melchizedek to inquire of the Lord concerning her conception.
And he said to her:
"Two nations are in your womb,
and one people shall be greater than the other people:"
Esau, that is Edom, from whom are the Edomites,
and Jacob, from whom are the Israelites.
Abimelech was a friend to the house of Isaac;
and he was the one who, in the hundredth year of Abraham, made war.
And the king of Gerar, the Scripture calls him by the name of his city,
and here [the king] of the Philistines,
because of the vast people over whom he ruled.
And in the days of Isaac, the fifth king arose over the Assyrians,
Ares,
[for] thirty years;
and the fifteenth king over the Egyptians,
Setis,
[for] nineteen years.
This is the first king of those four kings who were called "the Shepherds".
At the age of eighty-two years, he fathered Levi.
All the years of his life were one hundred and forty-seven years.
And when he was seventy-seven years old,
Isaac blessed him and sent him to Harran.
And in the tenth year of Levi,
Jacob went up to Isaac his father.
And in the third year of Levi,
Joseph was born.
And in the twentieth year of Levi,
Joseph was sold, being seventeen years old;
and he was a servant for ten years,
and in prison for three years,
and before Pharaoh for thirty years,
and he ruled over Egypt for eighty years,
and he died being one hundred and ten {one hundred and forty? OCR} years old.
And after Isaac died, the sons of Esau hired Moab and Ammon and Aram,
and they came to make war against {with} Jacob and his sons in Hebron.
And Jacob grew strong,
and shot Esau with an arrow and killed him.
And the sons of Esau were routed before the sons of Jacob,
and their helpers fled {OCR?}.
And when Jacob was one hundred and thirty years old,
he went down to Egypt in the second year of the famine.
After Jacob, Levi his son.
At the age of forty-seven years, he fathered Kohath.
All the years of his life were one hundred and thirty-seven years.
In his time occurred the flood that was in the days of Ogyges,
while Belos was reigning in Assyria;
and Moph (Memphis?) was built in Egypt.
